## TRA Timeline

#### De-SPAC and TRA execution

- 2020-06-12: Form-of TRA first carried as Annex I to the S-4 (Collier Creek / UBH business combination)
- 2020-08-28: De-SPAC closed; Collier Creek renamed Utz Brands, Inc.; TRA executed between Utz Brands, UBH, and the Rice-family Series U and Series R of UM Partners
- 2020-09-03: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.2 to the closing 8-K

## Explanation

Utz Brands, Inc. executed this TRA on August 28, 2020 at the closing of its de-SPAC Up-C business combination (Collier Creek Holdings merging with Utz Brands Holdings, LLC), agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings on a bundle of basis attributes: future Section 754 step-ups from Continuing Member exchanges, basis from the BSOF and Initial Purchases of UBH units at closing, imputed interest, and tax-amortization deductions tied to the 2019 Kennedy Endeavors (Conagra DSD snacks) asset acquisition that UBH consolidated into the same contract rather than spinning out as a parallel TRA. The Continuing Members are Series U and Series R of UM Partners, LLC, both Rice-family affiliates. Post-de-SPAC bolt-on acquisitions (Truco / On The Border tortilla chips in December 2020, R.W. Garcia, Kings Mountain) were structured as cash deals and did not add TRA Parties or amend the contract; the July 2023 Good Health / R.W. Garcia divestiture similarly did not touch the TRA. Carrying value held steady at $24.3M at both year-end 2023 and year-end 2024, consistent with few Continuing-Member exchanges to date. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
